risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Physical Crime (MT-5).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection (BCD-31) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Backups
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Backups (BCD-24) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Backup & Restoration Hardware Protection (BCD-31) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
